description: Run program-level architecture planning: kick the architect decomposition for EVERY still-DRAFT initiative in the program in one step (already-planned and standing-maintenance initiatives are skipped, reported per row). This spends tokens, the same tier as a single anyforge_dispatch_architect. Gated on the program brief clearing 100% ICE — a below-bar brief returns 409 `program_brief_below_bar` with the score and gaps; an OWNER may waive it with allowBriefBelowBar. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can dispatch crews.

acknowledgeCapacity.description: Acknowledge a capacity plan that misses (a logged decision, not a waiver).

allowBriefBelowBar.description: Owner-only waiver of the program-brief ICE gate. Ignored for a non-owner.

name: anyforge_architect_program
title: Architect program
